title: geocaryum divaricatum
intro: Geocaryum divaricatum, commonly known as Desert parsley, is a perennial plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the ability to treat fever, cough, and digestive issues due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Geocaryum divaricatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is required to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of Geocaryum divaricatum.
